jobs.title: Supply Chain Director
jobs.description: MedGrocer's digitally-enabled medicine programs, telehealth services, and corporate clinic medical staff work with hundreds of employers and pharma companies to improve the physical and mental health of over one million Filipinos every year. The Supply Chain Director architects the backbone of our pharmaceutical delivery system. You focus on securing global supply lines, optimizing cold-chain logistics, and leveraging technology to ensure that patients receive the right medicine at the right time, every time. Why Join MedGrocer? You will have the autonomy to design a state-of-the-art supply chain and lead high-impact logistics transformations. Your strategic oversight of our logistics network ensures that life-saving medications reach patients efficiently and safely. Direct enterprise-level procurement strategies to optimize costs while ensuring 100% inventory availability for critical medications. Lead the integration of advanced supply chain analytics and AI-driven forecasting to minimize waste and maximize fulfillment rates. Govern strategic relationships with global pharma manufacturers and third-party logistics (3PL) providers to ensure service level excellence. Oversee regulatory compliance for FDA pharmacy standards and logistics safety protocols at an enterprise scale. Growth & Impact: A clear path for professional development and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on patient health. Cross-Functional Learning: Opportunities to collaborate across different teams, expanding your skill set and broadening your understanding of the business. Process and monitor License to Operate (LTO) applications, renewals, and related regulatory requirements. Determine and monitor the appropriate Philippine FDA regulatory pathway for medical devices, including device classification and the documentation required for notification or registration, as applicable. Coordinate and follow up with the FDA and other relevant government agencies regarding pending applications, clarifications, deficiencies, and regulatory concerns. jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: Two designers. 20,000+ doctors. Millions of patients. That's our current ratio of team to impact. If you've worked on teams where your designs disappeared into endless review cycles, this is the opposite. SeriousMD and NowServing are healthcare products that people actually use daily. We need a Senior UI/UX Designer who can own product areas end-to-end, from research to shipped pixels. About Us Leapfroggr builds SeriousMD (the EMR platform Filipino doctors trust) and NowServing (connecting patients to providers nationwide). Our products handle real medical records, real appointments, real patient care. We're a small team by design. No layers, no approvals queue, no "let's circle back." You'll work directly with our Design Lead, engineers, and founders. What you design this week can ship next week. What You'll Actually Do Own UI/UX design for entire product areas across web, iOS, and Android. Take features from user research through wireframes through polished UI through shipped product. Build and extend our design system — we care about consistency at scale. Collaborate daily with engineering to make sure what ships matches what you designed. Run usability tests with real doctors and patients, then iterate based on what you learn. Present your work, defend your decisions, and stay open when you're wrong. What We Offer Remote-friendly (distributed across the Philippines) Health insurance Flexible hours Paid leave (sick, vacation, maternity/paternity, bereavement) Real ownership — your name is on the work, and the work matters How to Apply Send your portfolio showing your process, not just final screens. Tell us which of our products (SeriousMD or NowServing) you'd want to work on first, and why.
